+"""The token KV cache of a unified pool.
+
+`RoutedKVCache` is what attention backends, HiCache and the scheduler hold as a
+unified pool's `token_to_kv_pool`, for every set of sub-pools: each layer's
+reads and writes go to the view of the sub-pool its route names, with the
+layer id that view takes. It holds the views and the routes, never the
+allocator: write ids arrive already in each sub-pool's id space, and the id
+spaces are the allocator's (`ChainAllocator.id_spaces`).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.memory.views import MLAKVView
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.router import KVLayerRouter
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import (
+    KVCache,
+    KVWriteLoc,
+    unwrap_write_loc,
+    write_loc_is_physical,
+)
+
+
+class RoutedKVCache(KVCache):
+    """Routes every layer of a unified pool to its sub-pool's view.
+
+    ``layer_maps`` lists the token KV sub-pools in plan order: each one's name,
+    its view, and each routed model layer's index in that view, which is also
+    the layer id the view's methods take. The owner sub-pool's view answers
+    for the pool where one answer serves every layer (the value head dim, the
+    quantization method, the buffers a host stack anchors on).
+    """

+        self,
+        *,
+        unified_buffer,
+        owner: str,

+        start_layer: int,
+        end_layer: Optional[int],
+        size: int,
+        head_num: int,
+        head_dim: int,

+        # KVCache.__init__ allocates buffers; these views alias the unified
+        # buffer, which owns the memory.
+        self._unified_buffer = unified_buffer
+        self._owner = owner
+        self._layer_maps = tuple(layer_maps)
+        views = {name: view for name, view, _ in self._layer_maps}
+        self._owner_view = views[owner]
+        self.page_size = page_size
+        self.start_layer = start_layer
+        self.end_layer = end_layer
+        self.size = size

+"""The unified memory pool keeps no class per combination of KV kinds.

+A plan's sub-pools are routed by one `RoutedKVCache` and allocated by one
+`ChainAllocator`, whatever set of kinds the model declares. A class named for a
+combination (a window with full attention, recurrent state with a window, ...)
+would bring back one code path per combination. The classes listed below still
+name one and are on their way out.
+"""
+

+
+_COMBINATION = re.compile(r"^Unified(Draft)?(SWA|MambaSWA|SWAMamba|Hybrid)\w*")
+
+# Remaining classes that name a combination, with what removes them.
+_ALLOWED = {
+    # The fused draft's pool: drafts are read per sub-pool instead.
+    "UnifiedDraftSWAKVPool",
+    # The request table of a plan with state: rows and slot-id columns of
+    # every sub-pool that holds per-request rows.
+    "UnifiedHybridReqToTokenPool",
+}
+
+
+def _combination_classes():
+    srt = pathlib.Path(sglang.__file__).parent / "srt"
+    found = set()
+    for path in srt.rglob("*.py"):
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(path.read_text())):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and _COMBINATION.match(node.name):
+                found.add(node.name)
+    return found
+
+
+class TestNoCombinationClasses(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_no_new_combination_class(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_combination_classes() - _ALLOWED, set())

+    def test_allowed_classes_still_exist(self):
+        # An entry whose class is gone is removed from the list with it.
+        self.assertEqual(_ALLOWED - _combination_classes(), set())
+
